name: Agent Blueprint
description: Methodology and platform for designing and deploying enterprise AI agent teams. Each engagement produces a living blueprint: readiness evidence, a ranked use-case portfolio, agent team designs, business cases, and Agent Skills directories for coding agents. Enterprise work is delivered through hands-on engagements. A personal blueprint, which a coding agent draws of itself when its person asks, has no sign-up: https://agentblueprint.ai/personal

best_next_actions.when: your person asks you to draw a blueprint of yourself
